speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent, and I will be examining you. Since you are a newborn with a generalized rash, can you describe exactly where the rash started and if it has spread to your eyes or mouth?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: That history of maternal gonorrhea is concerning. Can you describe the appearance of the rash and tell me if the baby has any eye discharge, coughing, or difficulty breathing? REQUEST TEST: CBC with Differential, CRP. REQUEST IMAGES: Rash_close_up, Eye_exam.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules with an erythematous base observed over the trunk and extremities. Palms and soles are spared. No eye discharge, coughing, or difficulty breathing observed. CBC with Differential and CRP not available. Rash_close_up and Eye_exam images not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Infection (Disseminated Gonococcal Infection).
